about_the_game:
Ecto is a highly-randomized nature world, featuring smooth, addictive movement. Jump around on colorful, nature-inspired floating islands with your friends or solo. Pick up trinkets, buy and upgrade stick guns, hang out with frogs and fight robots in the underworld.

ROADMAP:

[X] Started Development of Ecto (October 2022)

[X] Prototype Version 1.0 (October 6th 2023)

[X] Prototype Version 2.0 (January 12th 2024

[X] Prototype Version 3.0 (April 4th 2024)

[X] Steam Prototype Release (April 30th 2024)

[X] Pre-Alpha 1.0 | Boss and Progression Update (November 11th 2024)

[X] Pre-Alpha 2.0 | BIG UPDATE / Scavenger Hunt Update (March 13th 2025)

[X] Pre-Alpha 3.0 | Polishing / Content update (June 1st 2025)

[X] Pre-Alpha 4.0 | Content update (August 30th 2025)

[  ] Alpha

[  ] Beta

[  ] Full Release

DISCLAIMER:

Keep in mind that Ecto is still in the prototype stage and lacks content. My main goal is to lock in the gameplay fundamentals before I start adding more stuff.

Leave feedback or just come say hi!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Tested on Debian x64
  • Processor: 2.4GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Your GPU must have Vulkan support. If not, I added a compatibility mode for older GPUs

Recommended:
  • OS: Tested on Debian x64
  • Processor: 2.4GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Play solo or online co-op up to 8 players. Bunny hop around at extreme speeds while blasting robots with flower guns. CLICK EVERYTHING- Pick up frogs, interact with flowers, mushrooms and other interactive bits in a randomly generated world.
